text: Android: list name/category order go stale; top bar shows 'List' not the list's name

Top-bar title detail: AppDrawerScaffold takes title as a plain String literal
from Nav.kt (param at Nav.kt:184; call sites pass "List"/"Registry"/"List
properties"). The ListViewModel that knows the name lives INSIDE the scaffold's
content lambda, not above it, so you can't just read it at the call site.
Cleanest options: (a) resolve the name in the Nav composable itself (it has
listId) via a small repo/VM read and pass it as title, or (b) drop the scaffold
title for list/registry/props and give those screens their own TopAppBar. For
the live-data part there's precedent: ListDao.activeLists() is already a Flow —
add observeById(id): Flow<ListEntity?> in parallel. Confirmed ListPropsViewModel
.init has the identical load-once staleness.

Done in 1af5ecb (feature) + 1d594d5 (test-flake fix). Implemented option (a) from
note#1: added ListDao.observeById(id): Flow<ListEntity?> + ListsRepo.observeById;
ListViewModel now collects it (name + categoryOrder live, re-groups on emit). Top
bar: a tiny ListTitleViewModel scoped to the nav back-stack entry resolves the live
name for the scaffold title on list/registry/props (labels kept as fallback while
loading). Tests: ListViewModelTest (+rename-live, +category-order-live),
new ListTitleViewModelTest.

Deliberately NOT done, with reasons:
- ListPropsViewModel left load-once. It's an editor: the name field and category
  order are in-progress edit state, and live-updating them mid-edit would clobber
  the user's typing/reorder. The props TOP BAR title, however, IS now live (via the
  same liveListTitle), so you can still tell which list you're editing.
- defaultCurrency liveness within an already-open screen deferred: SessionState is
  EncryptedSharedPreferences, not observable, so making it live isn't "cheap" as the
  body hoped. It already applies on the next list open (covered by ListViewModelTest
  "a currency change made in Settings is reflected by the next list view (A10)").
  Worth a dedicated ticket if in-place liveness is wanted.

Verified: :app:testDebugUnitTest + :app:lintDebug green (148 tests). The lone
recurring flaky Compose test (AddItemDialogTest) was root-caused and fixed under
T-29 in the same push - see that ticket.

Follow-up race fix in 70e7325 (surfaced while verifying T-47): the three-live-flow
init this ticket introduced (observeById + todo items + checked items, each calling
regroup()) could regroup from a half-loaded snapshot, since the item streams arrive
off Dispatchers.IO before the list row — a brief wrong-order flash on open when the
list has an explicit category_order, and a nondeterministic failure of the
"groups follow category_order" test (passed in T-34's own run, failed later under
different scheduling). Fixed by folding the three into one combine(), which holds
the first grouped emission until all inputs are present. No behavior change beyond
removing the flash; liveness tests still pass.
